target: G_t = sum(rewards[t:30]); features after observing o_t and before action a_t
standardization: fitting transitions only; zero-variance columns scale=1
ridge_objective: mean squared error + alpha * squared coefficient norm; unpenalized intercept
heldout_definition: Test episodes from a fixed random episode-level split; validation chooses ridge alpha only
remaining_limits: One frozen checkpoint and one greedy policy; episode uncertainty is not training-run uncertainty.
History features can correlate with returns without causing defensive success.
Additional linear decoding signal does not establish benefit to the actor or a causal memory mechanism.
Categorical usage under posterior modes alone cannot prove posterior collapse.
